change: Separate a known adoption preparation refusal before Core invocation from uncertain physical movement. Consume the original reservation into a typed negative capture, atomically record its exact not-started observation and failed effect, and retire only the candidate under actual native absence. Keep the source/retained programme and original attempt; no Ready and no movement replay.
checks_pending: Compile Store and run only three new exact cases in commit::not_submitted on local Ubuntu24 ARM.
Compile changed Service wiring as part of the corrected mixer libtest; an actual native adoption-preparation fault remains a separate unproved integration case.
intended_coverage: Complete writer refusal and real SQLite second-write rollback leave snapshots unchanged.
Only exact original candidate/generation absence permits cleanup after the sealed non-submission capture.
Effect identity, attempt, submission generation, no Ready, positive original-source/retained authorization and duplicate outcome/cleanup are conserved.
Uncaptured, uncertain and confirmed movements remain excluded from candidate-only cleanup.
An existing live negative capture can settle generic unknown metadata, but cannot cross successor ownership; the unknown metadata in this case is fixture-injected, not a process-crash proof.
limitations: Store absence is a fixture fact, not actual Core/Service failure injection or media continuity.
This does not close native cancellation/publication ordering, video/bootstrap, authenticated epochs or transport qualification.
